name: HaystackCraft
description: HaystackCraft is a needle-in-a-haystack benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on long-context understanding using ranked distractors from various retrieval systems. It assesses LLM performance degradation with increasing context size and the impact of distractor composition on retrieval-based tasks.
reputation: A newer long-context benchmark that is useful for probing retrieval robustness, but it has limited broad adoption compared with established long-context suites.
notes: Built on full English Wikipedia hyperlink network; evaluates impact of distractor types including graph-based reranking.
